# V2 artifact facts — independent UI review, round 3

Verdict: **PASS**, limited to current-source static UI-facing data semantics. No blocking findings in this scope.

Reviewed current source against `review-source-snapshot-round3.json`, the task brief/acceptance plan, pinned Studio/SDK extracts, the prior frozen implementation and tests, and the authorized existing-file diff. Base HEAD remains `ac58815bb268d338bea40a31fff630734cd719f4`, branch `android-studio-task/1-v2-artifact-facts`, worktree `/workspace/android-studio-source-providers`. This verdict applies to the current identities below, not the old round-1 source. The prior report is retained unchanged.

## Current UI-facing behavior

- Raw SDK generated source/resource/assets folders remain vectors separate from generated classpaths (`crates/android_tools/src/generated_artifacts.rs:262`). No JAR-to-source conversion, filename-derived source identity, visible-folder policy, Kotlin facet inference, tree controller or renderer is added. The module's explicit raw/light-class/KAPT limitation remains at lines 17–18.
- Available-empty, unavailable and not-applicable getter fields remain distinct (`generated_artifacts.rs:123`); absent SDK artifacts remain distinct from present artifacts (`generated_artifacts.rs:308`). The bridge now checks Collection/Map types before `collect` (`project_model.gradle:313`) so a null SDK collection/map becomes a captured capability failure, not an apparently successful empty tree. Explicit null sidecars and available-null folder vectors are malformed; missing legacy sidecars remain `MissingMetadata`.
- Host-test Java artifacts cannot invent Android resource/assets/task fields. The bridge emits not-applicable for Android-only getters, and Rust now requires not-applicable for Java `sourceGenTaskName` and `resGenTaskName` (`generated_artifacts.rs:804`). Available(null) and unavailable are rejected for these nonexistent Java getters. Android optional task values retain their own independent semantics.
- Object-only wire decoding (`generated_artifacts.rs:35`, registrations at line 822, generic captured-field wrapper at line 838) rejects positional arrays as envelope, DTO or status objects. It leaves actual vector fields, signed numeric versions, optional descriptions/task names and the scalar artifact-kind tag in their native forms. Malformed wire shape therefore cannot silently map positions to UI-facing metadata.
- The streaming outer-record DTO (`generated_artifacts.rs:426`) ignores unrelated Basic payload while distinguishing sidecar omission from explicit null. Basic model parsing and the caller-owned Basic model remain separate. The subsequent zipped module validation (line 527) occurs only after exact ordered module/directory identity agreement (line 511), and preserves stored collection ordering.
- Folder duplicates and encounter order remain intact. Validation sets check unique SDK map keys and variant membership without sorting stored raw vectors. Exact variant lookup reports `MissingVariant` rather than selecting a substitute (`generated_artifacts.rs:379`). Feature gates remain producer >=11.0 for assets and producer >=8.9 OR AGP >=8.2.0-alpha07 for classpaths (line 177), matching retained pinned BasicModules.kt. Unsupported legacy assets retain their raw facts and require a proved legacy conversion before a feature-aware consumer can use them.
- Snapshot freshness remains an explicit revision/root/module/directory/variant identity check (`generated_artifacts.rs:366`). A future controller must use this check before publishing results. There is no current UI publication path in this task, so this review does not establish refresh, selection or stale-update behavior in the application.

## Reference and test boundary

Pinned `GradleProjectSystem.kt:439`/468 and `GradleProjectSystemUtil.java:171` require generated-source conversion/filtering before a visible Studio provider is constructed. This transport still deliberately exports raw SDK folders; AAPT, data-binding base-class, Safe Args and external KAPT policies remain pending. It receives no parity credit for visible root grouping, Studio folder ordering, generated/light-class tree rendering, facet equivalence, or any of the five original AndroidProjectViewTest flows.

There are **28 declared Rust tests**, not executed by this reviewer. Static inspection covers the two complete original ordering tests, prior boundary tests and appended null, Java task applicability, unrelated-payload and positional-shape cases. The complete round-2 27-test file is a byte-identical prefix of the current file. The original ordering tuples, signed extrema, descriptions, reversed input and full-record equality assertions remain unchanged. The canonical matrix and all existing source/fixtures/tests remain unchanged.

## Verified source guards

At review start and again immediately before writing this report, all **8 frozen review files**, **184 immutable originals**, **31 cited references**, and **11 historical probe files** matched their recorded hashes. Existing tracked-file changes remain limited to the additive module export and authorized Gradle bridge. Historical SDK probes were identity-checked only and do not serve as current runtime proof.

## Limits and remaining gates

No Cargo, compiler, Clippy, Gradle, application launch, screenshot capture, cache mutation, source modification or subagent dispatch occurred. This is a static data-semantics PASS, not a screenshot/visual-fidelity or performance PASS. Current-source Rust tests, SDK probes, repository quality checks and matching-source full app/native/full workspace gates remain required before task completion and lead integration. Phase 1 and the IDE remain incomplete.
